title: Outbound DNS beaconing detected from workstation-47
raw_description: Workstation-47 generated outbound DNS queries every 30 seconds to randomized subdomains of suspicious-control.example. The pattern began after a successful login from 203.0.113.45 and may indicate command-and-control beaconing, malware persistence, or post-compromise activity.
normalized_text: Workstation-47 is repeatedly querying randomized subdomains of suspicious-control.example every 30 seconds after a suspicious successful login from 203.0.113.45.
